standards.desc: Use ratio language to describe a relationship between two quantities
Understand unit rate a/b for a ratio a:b and use rate language
Use ratio and rate reasoning with tables, tape diagrams, double number lines and percents
Divide fractions by fractions and solve word problems with fraction division
Fluently divide multi-digit numbers with the standard algorithm
Fluently add, subtract, multiply and divide multi-digit decimals
Find greatest common factor and least common multiple; use the distributive property
Use positive and negative numbers to represent quantities in real-world contexts
Locate rational numbers on number lines and coordinate planes
standards.q: negative numbers on the number line coordinate plane

standards.desc: Order rational numbers and understand absolute value
Solve problems by graphing points in all four quadrants, including distance
Write and evaluate numerical expressions with whole-number exponents
Write, read and evaluate expressions in which letters stand for numbers
Apply properties of operations to generate equivalent expressions
Identify when two expressions are equivalent
Understand solving an equation or inequality as finding values that make it true
Use variables to represent numbers and write expressions for real-world problems
Solve one-step equations of the form x + p = q and px = q
Write inequalities of the form x > c or x < c and graph them
Use variables to represent two quantities that change in relationship to one another
Find the area of triangles, quadrilaterals and polygons by composing and decomposing
standards.q: area of triangles and composite figures

standards.desc: Find the volume of right rectangular prisms with fractional edge lengths
Draw polygons in the coordinate plane given vertices; find side lengths
Represent 3D figures with nets and use them to find surface area
Recognize a statistical question as one that anticipates variability
Understand that a data distribution has a center, spread and overall shape
Recognize that center and variability measures summarize a data set
Display numerical data in dot plots, histograms and box plots
Summarize numerical data sets in relation to their context
Compute unit rates with ratios of fractions
Recognize and represent proportional relationships between quantities
Use proportional relationships to solve multistep ratio and percent problems
standards.q: percent word problems markup discount tax

standards.desc: Add and subtract rational numbers; represent them on a number line
Multiply and divide rational numbers
Solve real-world problems with the four operations on rational numbers
Add, subtract, factor and expand linear expressions with rational coefficients
standards.q: combining like terms factoring linear expressions

standards.desc: Rewrite an expression in different forms to show how quantities are related
Solve multi-step real-life problems with rational numbers in any form
Use variables to construct and solve equations and inequalities
Solve problems involving scale drawings of geometric figures
Draw geometric shapes with given conditions, especially triangles
Describe the 2D cross-sections of slicing 3D figures
Know and use the formulas for the area and circumference of a circle
Use facts about supplementary, complementary, vertical and adjacent angles
Solve problems involving area, volume and surface area of 2D and 3D objects
standards.q: volume and surface area word problems

standards.desc: Understand that random sampling supports valid inferences about a population
Use data from a random sample to draw inferences about a population
Informally assess the overlap of two numerical data distributions
Use measures of center and variability to compare two populations
Understand that probability is a number between 0 and 1
Approximate probability by collecting data and observing relative frequency
Develop probability models and use them to find probabilities
Find probabilities of compound events with lists, tables, tree diagrams and simulation
Know that numbers that are not rational are irrational; convert repeating decimals
Use rational approximations of irrational numbers to compare and locate them
Know and apply the properties of integer exponents
Use square root and cube root symbols; evaluate small perfect squares and cubes
Use numbers in scientific notation to estimate very large or small quantities
Perform operations with numbers in scientific notation
Graph proportional relationships and interpret the unit rate as slope
Use similar triangles to explain slope; derive y = mx and y = mx + b
Solve linear equations in one variable, including ones with no or infinite solutions
standards.q: linear equations with variables on both sides

standards.desc: Analyze and solve pairs of simultaneous linear equations
Understand that a function assigns to each input exactly one output
Compare properties of two functions represented in different ways
Interpret y = mx + b as defining a linear function; give examples of nonlinear ones
Construct a function to model a linear relationship; interpret rate of change
Describe a functional relationship qualitatively by analyzing a graph
Verify properties of rotations, reflections and translations
Understand congruence through a sequence of rigid transformations
Describe the effect of dilations, translations, rotations and reflections with coordinates
Understand similarity through transformations including dilations
Use informal arguments about angle sums, exterior angles and parallel lines cut by a transversal
standards.q: angles parallel lines transversal triangle angle sum

standards.desc: Explain a proof of the Pythagorean theorem and its converse
Apply the Pythagorean theorem to find unknown side lengths
Apply the Pythagorean theorem to find the distance between two points
Know and use the volume formulas for cones, cylinders and spheres
Construct and interpret scatter plots for bivariate data
Informally fit a straight line to a scatter plot and assess the fit
Use a linear model to solve problems and interpret slope and intercept
Understand patterns of association in two-way tables of categorical data
Explain how rational exponents follow from properties of integer exponents
Rewrite expressions involving radicals and rational exponents
Explain why sums and products of rational and irrational numbers are rational or irrational
standards.q: sums and products of irrational numbers

standards.desc: Use units to understand problems and guide multi-step solutions
Define appropriate quantities for descriptive modeling
Choose a level of accuracy appropriate to limitations on measurement
Interpret expressions that represent a quantity in terms of its context
Use the structure of an expression to identify ways to rewrite it
Choose and produce an equivalent form of an expression to reveal properties
Add, subtract and multiply polynomials
Identify zeros of polynomials when suitable factorizations are available
Create equations and inequalities in one variable and use them to solve problems
Create equations in two or more variables and graph them
Represent constraints with equations or inequalities and interpret solutions
Rearrange formulas to highlight a quantity of interest
Explain each step in solving a simple equation
Solve linear equations and inequalities in one variable
Solve quadratic equations in one variable
Prove that elimination produces a system with the same solutions
Solve systems of linear equations exactly and approximately
Understand that the graph of an equation is the set of all its solutions
Explain why the x-coordinates of intersection points solve f(x) = g(x)
Graph the solutions to a linear inequality in two variables as a half-plane
Understand that a function assigns each input exactly one output; use f(x) notation
Use function notation, evaluate functions and interpret statements in context
Recognize that sequences are functions defined on the integers
Interpret key features of graphs and tables of a function in context
Relate the domain of a function to its graph and context
Calculate and interpret the average rate of change of a function
Graph functions expressed symbolically and show key features
Write a function in different but equivalent forms to reveal properties
standards.q: forms of quadratic functions vertex form

standards.desc: Compare properties of two functions represented in different ways
Write a function that describes a relationship between two quantities
Identify the effect of replacing f(x) with f(x) + k, k f(x), f(kx) and f(x + k)
Distinguish between situations modeled by linear and exponential functions
Construct linear and exponential functions from graphs, descriptions or tables
Observe that exponential growth eventually exceeds linear and polynomial growth
standards.q: exponential vs linear growth over time

standards.desc: Interpret the parameters in a linear or exponential function in context
Represent data with plots on the real number line
Use statistics appropriate to the shape of the data to compare center and spread
Interpret differences in shape, center and spread, accounting for outliers
standards.q: outliers effect on mean and median

standards.desc: Summarize categorical data for two categories in two-way frequency tables
Represent data on two quantitative variables on a scatter plot and fit a function
Interpret the slope and intercept of a linear model in context
Compute and interpret the correlation coefficient of a linear fit
Distinguish between correlation and causation
